board.note: 24 narrow triangles (points) numbered 1-24; White moves from 24 toward 1, Black moves from 1 toward 24

bar.note: Checkers hit by the opponent are placed here and must re-enter before any other move

bearing_off.note: Checkers that have been borne off the board

movement.condition: destination has 0 or 1 opponent checkers OR destination has friendly checkers
all own checkers are in home board

checker.note: Each player has 15 checkers; moved forward along the track by dice values

dice.note: Two standard six-sided dice rolled each turn

phases.name: roll
phases.note: Player rolls both dice; doubles grant 4 uses of the rolled value instead of 2

phases.name: move
phases.ends_when: all die values used OR no legal moves remain
phases.note: Player must use as many die values as legally possible; if only one can be used, the higher value must be chosen

initial_setup.definition: White: 2 on point 1, 5 on point 12, 3 on point 17, 5 on point 19. Black: mirrored (2 on point 24, 5 on point 13, 3 on point 8, 5 on point 6).

constraints: each die value is used as a separate move
a checker may land on a point that is empty, has friendly checkers, or has exactly 1 opponent checker
a point with 2 or more opponent checkers is blocked

doubles.effect: player gets 4 moves of that value instead of 2

hitting.trigger: checker lands on a point occupied by exactly 1 opponent checker
hitting.effect: opponent checker is moved to bar

re_entry.constraint: a player with checkers on the bar must re-enter them before moving any other checker
re_entry.effect: checker enters opponent's home board at the point matching the die value

requires: all 15 of the player's checkers are in their home board (points 1-6 for White, 19-24 for Black)
constraints: a checker on the point matching the die value may be borne off
if no checker is on the exact point, a checker from the highest occupied point lower than the die value may be borne off

must_use_all_dice.constraint: player must use as many die values as legally possible; if both values can be used but not both, the higher must be used

end_conditions.condition: all 15 of current player's checkers are in bearing_off
end_conditions.name: bear_off_all

end_conditions.condition: all 15 of current player's checkers are in bearing_off AND opponent has checkers on the bar or in current player's home board
end_conditions.name: backgammon

end_conditions.condition: all 15 of current player's checkers are in bearing_off AND opponent has not borne off any checkers
end_conditions.name: gammon
